# Subway Seat for Nushell

The fish port's command-line colours as a `color_config`, plus table output where file sizes and ages run down the 70s stripe. It turns on `highlight_resolved_externals`, so unknown commands show red as they do in fish.

[Nushell](https://www.nushell.sh) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/nushell/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.nu`](subway-seat.nu) | ~/.config/nushell/themes/subway-seat.nu |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.nu`](subway-seat-tunnel.nu) | ~/.config/nushell/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.nu |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.nu`](subway-seat-enamel.nu) | ~/.config/nushell/themes/subway-seat-enamel.nu |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in config.nu (`$nu.config-path`):

```text
source ~/.config/nushell/themes/subway-seat.nu
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in config.nu (`$nu.config-path`):

```text
source ~/.config/nushell/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.nu
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in config.nu (`$nu.config-path`):

```text
source ~/.config/nushell/themes/subway-seat-enamel.nu
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
